get.description: The attention box for the signed-in user, as the Today page builds it (only employees with an HR row).
The items of one Анхаарах group past the first GROUP_LIMIT, or a page of a gap group with `all=1`.

post.description: "Мэдлээ" / "Дахин харуулах" on one Анхаарах item or a whole group; answers with the box.
«Хийгдсэн» on a checklist task the user owns (404 when the user may not tick it, 409 when it is refused).

get.description: The company figures page (403 without the employee-list right, as company_page).
The header, rail and rights of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise).

One batch of the «Түүх» drawer for an employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise), as activity_more:
50 entries from `offset` (a junk offset is 0), the day heading of the entry above, and the next offset.

post.description: Correct one job row; the reason is required. A refused correction answers 200 with ok false.

get.description: The pop-up to correct one job row (403 without the manage right or for a scheduled row).

post.description:
Create the employee's login and answer its temporary password once (no-store). An invalid username is a 400
with field_errors["username"]; a refused creation (a second login, a taken name) is a 400 with form_errors.
Add a note to the employee's activity log (a manager's right; 404 outside the user's scope, 403 without it).

get.description:
The header, work and bank fields and the salary fields of one employee the user may see, with their stored
values (404 outside the user's scope; 403 without the manage or the salary right).

The personal tab of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise; 403 without the personal right):
the topic groups with their chips, the four field sections, and the personal lists.

post.description:
Save one section of the personal tab (the same save as the Django section form). Business outcomes answer
200 with the result; an unknown section is 404, a user without the manage and personal rights is 403.
Add one row of a personal list. A refused form answers 200 with ok false; an unknown list is 404.

get.description:
The pop-up of one personal-list row: an add form (no key) or the edit form of the row `key`. An address takes
city, district and street as presets so the district choices follow the city (the Django pop-up's rule).

post.description:
Change one row of a personal list if it still matches the loaded values posted back (a changed row answers
200 with ok false and the message in form_errors). Missing loaded values: 400, nothing written; unknown row: 404.
Delete one row of a personal list, on the loaded values posted back (same rules as the edit).

get.description:
The Salary tab of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise; 403 without the salary right):
today's pay, the pay history rows and the «Банк, даатгал» block.

post.description: Set the first salary and write its activity entry. A refused form answers 200 with ok false.

get.description:
The pop-up to set the first salary (404 outside the user's scope; 403 without the salary right or once a salary
exists).

post.description: Correct one salary row; the reason is required. A refused correction answers 200 with ok false.

get.description: The pop-up to correct one salary row (403 for a scheduled row; 404 for another employee's row).

post.description:
Save what the user may change on the employee page. `values_json` is a JSON object of HTML name -> string
(the fields, `loaded`, `si-loaded` and any `resolve-<name>`). Business outcomes answer 200 with the result.

Tick or untick one setup item (Бүрдүүлэлт) while the employee's checklist is open. 403 without the manage right
or once the checklist is closed; a system item answers 400.

get.description:
The Work tab of one employee the signed-in user may see (404 otherwise): job, contract, MACS fields, the
history, the waiting changes, the other orders, the leave block and the checklist panels.
The My page of the signed-in user (its own record only; 404 without an employee record).

post.description: «Мэдлээ» on one result notice. Only a notice of the user's own request can be dismissed (404 otherwise).
«Буцаах»: the user takes back their own waiting request. Someone else's request is 404; a refused change 409.

get.description: The names of people away on one day of the Today strip (`?day=YYYY-MM-DD`, inside the 14-day window).
The names of people who joined in the last 30 days (the hires line of «Ойрын 30 хоног»).
The birthdays or the work anniversaries in the next 30 days (`?kind=birthday|anniversary`).
The report setups that say what is coming up, with their counts (empty without reports.view_reports).
